heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 94–350, title V, § 516, July 12, 1976, 90 Stat. 845

notes.text: Section, act Aug. 13, 1946, ch. 957, title VIII, § 854, 60 Stat. 1024, provided for credit while on military leave. See section 4045 of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Oct. 1, 1976, see Pub. L. 94–350, title V, § 524(a), July 12, 1976, 90 Stat. 848.
